notes: «عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text.
«قال: سألته عن الرجل» is Ali's question; the Imam asked is already the last link.
